title: Exchange project memories between hosts so every host's agents share the same recorded rules and context
outcome: Exchange project memories between hosts so every host's agents share the same recorded rules and context
acceptance: A design, reviewed before coding, states how keyed project memories (revisions, attribution, retiring targets, forget tombstones, restricted bodies) travel between hosts through the existing task-sync data branch or another explicit operation, how concurrent revisions of one key on two hosts are resolved without silent loss, and what is never transferred

After the change, a memory remembered or revised on host A is readable with the same key, revision history and attribution on host B after one documented sync operation, and a forget on A retires the key on B; shown on real Windows and DL560 or Mac hosts
docs/features/git-task-sync.md no longer states that project memories are outside the profile, or states exactly which parts still are

completion.summary: Implemented and landed project-memory exchange on the task-sync data branch. Exact candidate 037e45c2be216a45fa6ad2428fdf77c5f3e2c5af (tree e1758587a42fc9319fe9544a2340e39f8524d410) is on origin/master; installed build fingerprint 9d134f9ff15627be508ea5728c690037a4d7b223764e531f546b78d33bba8155 is ready on all six live stores.
